died.name: François Rabelais
died.last_words: Bring down the curtain, the farce is played out.

died.name: Francis Bacon
died.cause: John Aubrey reported in Brief Lives that the English philosopher and statesman died of pneumonia after stuffing a chicken carcass with snow to learn whether it could preserve meat.
died.last_words: Thy creatures, O Lord, have been my books, but Thy Holy Scriptures much more. I have sought Thee in the fields and gardens, but I have found Thee, O God, in Thy Sanctuary-Thy Temple.

died.name: Simon Fraser, 11th Lord Lovat
died.cause: quoting a line of Horace when executed by beheading as a Jacobite rebel
died.last_words: Dulce et decorum est pro patria mori.

died.name: Lewis Benedict
died.desc: American politician and Union colonel of the American Civil War
died.cause: before being killed at the Battle of Pleasant Hill
died.last_words: Colonel, rally your men and advance as soon as possible.

died.name: Dante Gabriel Rossetti
died.last_words: Then you really think I am dying? At last you think so. But I was right from the first.

died.name: Zip the Pinhead
died.last_words: Well, we fooled 'em for a long time, didn't we?

born.name: Timur
born.desc: Turco-Mongol conqueror, founder of the Timurid Empire
born.last_words: Never yet has death been frightened away by screaming.

born.name: James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth
born.desc: illegitimate son of Charles II of England
born.cause: to Jack Ketch, his executioner. Ketch was nervous and took several blows to behead Scott
born.last_words: There are six guineas for you, and do not hack me as you did my Lord Russell. I have heard that you struck him three or four times. My servant will give you more gold if you do your work well.

born.name: Fisher Ames
born.desc: member of the U.S. House of Representatives
born.last_words: I have peace of mind. It may arise from stupidity, but I think it is founded on a belief of the Gospel. My hope is in the mercy of God through Jesus Christ.

born.name: Milburn G. Apt
born.cause: final radio transmission while losing control of Bell X-2
